results.note: Many red and green autumn leaves overlap on a branch. The three-lobed outline reads, but the leaves are crowded and the small teeth need study. Autumn colour means it is not the usual look.
A leafy branch of green mature leaves with red stalks, and a few curled leaves that show pale undersides. The leaves are crowded, so the teeth and the stalk joins take some study.

Yellow, green and red autumn leaves on a twig, where the red stalks join the twig in opposite pairs. Behind them is a busy background of other coloured leaves, and the autumn colour means it is not the usual look.
A whole mossy trunk seen from a distance. Moss covers much of the bark, so the texture, the pattern and the colour take study.

Crowded yellow autumn leaves are seen from below against a bright sky, with a red tree in the background. Bright sun and the view from below make the outlines and the edges hard to read, and the foreground leaves do not show clear lobes.
A sapling with red autumn leaves in an overgrown scene. The leaves blend into a mass, and no leaf margin can be read.
One whole green three-lobed leaf with coarse teeth and a red stalk, against a soft background. The stalk join at the twig is only partly in frame.
A lichen-spotted trunk seen from a distance in an autumn forest. The bark is small in the frame, and the background foliage competes with it.
A multi-stemmed trunk base with ridged, scaly old bark. Backlight in the upper middle lightens part of the frame.
A sharp close-up of grey bark with scaly ridges and lichen. Texture only, with no trunk edge or scale.
A fallen red leaf lies on the ground among brown dead leaves and a mushroom. The subject is a dead, fallen leaf, and the litter around it competes.
Shaggy old bark with long plates that curl away from the trunk. A hand at the left edge gives scale. The small file is sharp.
A close-up of grey, scaly, ridged bark. It is texture only, and the edges soften from the lens while the centre stays sharp.
A trunk section with both edges in frame, showing grey bark with long narrow plates and shallow furrows.
One whole three-lobed toothed leaf in red, orange and green, in front of hemlock branches. The autumn colour means it is not the usual look.
The camera looks up the trunk into the crown, with a birdhouse on the trunk and strong sun flare. The view from below and the glare make the bark hard to read.
Crowded orange-brown autumn leaves are backlit and in soft focus, with overlapping blades. The backlight and the crowding make the outline and the edge take study.
A sharp close-up of a three-lobed red and green leaf with clear teeth and veins. The left lobe tip reaches the frame edge, and the autumn colour means it is not the usual look.
A trunk with both edges in frame and grey bark that breaks into shallow, narrow, flaking strips over a smoother surface.
A carpet of fallen red and brown dead leaves on the ground. Each leaf is small in the frame, and no margin can be read.

Pale samara clusters hang from a branch among new leaves, seen from below against the sky. Backlight washes out the wing colour, and the crowded clusters and leaves make the single-fruit shape a search.
Close view of green-pink samara pairs against a dark background. The wings are full size but still green, so they are unripe. The stalks show, but not how they join the twig.
Red samara clusters hang on long stalks from a bare twig against a plain blue sky. Shape, wing, and hang are all easy to read.
Close view in sunlight of red samara clusters hanging from a twig, with a soft background. The fruit features are clear.
Green-red samaras hang on long stalks from a twig, in front of a soft background. Warm, low backlight tints the wings, and the full-size green fruits are still unripe.
Frame-filling view of old bark with scaly plates and furrows, with no trunk edge or scale object, so it is too close. Warm, low sun shifts the colour.
Pink samara clusters hang on red stalks from a twig, with soft new leaves behind. The fruits are full shape but still unripe.
The lower trunk stands on a lawn, and the whole trunk width shows its grey bark with shallow vertical fissures. The bark is seen from a distance, so the texture is a search.
One whole lobed maple leaf hangs from its long petiole in front of a dark background. Harsh, flash-like light gives the green a grey sheen.
Newly formed samaras with small red wings sit on green stalks, in front of a soft background. They have not reached full shape, so the kind and the shape take close study.
Scan of one whole green, five-lobed leaf on black. Outline, lobe tips, margin, and veins are all clear.
One whole green lobed leaf lies flat on bark mulch. The outline and margin are easy to read against the busy but distinct background.
Dense clusters of red-orange samaras hang from pale branches against a black background. Flash light changes the colour, and the crowded clusters make the shape of a single samara a search.
Close view of pink samara clusters hanging on red stalks from a twig, with soft green leaves behind. The fruits are full shape but unripe.
Frame-filling view of old, scaly, furrowed bark, with no trunk edge or scale object, so it is too close. The plates and ridges are clear.
A crown of orange autumn foliage where the leaves blend into a mass. No single leaf outline or margin can be read.
Lobed leaves on a branch, seen from below, with brown spots. Several overlapping leaves and a busy park background compete, so the margin and the stalk joins take study.
Many red samara clusters on bare branches, seen from below against pine foliage and sky. The fruits are small in the frame and the background is busy, so kind and shape are a search.
Very young red samaras hang on long stalks from a twig against a cloudy sky. The fruits have not reached full shape, and the backlight darkens them.
Fallen red-and-yellow autumn leaves with dark spots, with one central lobed leaf. Other leaves overlap it and crowd the frame, and sun and shadow patches change the colour.
A hanging green leaf seen from below shows its pale underside with full lobes and teeth; a second leaf sits beside it on a soft background. Angle because the leaf is viewed from underneath.
Trunk with both edges in frame shows grey bark in long, curling vertical plates and strips. Nothing makes it harder.
Wide trunk with edges and a building behind shows furrowed grey bark with plates lifting at the edges. Nothing makes it harder.
A single whole green five-lobed leaf on a plain white background, upper side, with clear lobes and sparse teeth. Nothing makes it harder.
The camera looks up an old trunk into the crown and its branches; the ridges show only on the lower trunk. Rejected as a look up into the crown, with angle as the cause.
Trunk with both edges shows grey-brown bark in long vertical plates with some lifting strips. Nothing makes it harder.
A garden scene with a sapling among hostas and a spruce trunk; the leaves blend into a mass and no single leaf margin can be read.
A whole sapling in a lawn bed in front of arborvitae; the leaves blend into a mass and no single leaf margin can be read.

A twig with a hanging cluster of paired samaras with green seeds, plus leaves, on a black background. The leaves compete with the fruit, flash lighting changes the colour, and the green seeds mark the fruit as unripe.
A crown of orange autumn leaves seen from below; the leaves blend into a mass and no single margin can be read. Autumn colour makes it an unusual look.
The base of an old, gnarled, mossy trunk with large limbs in long grass; the plates show at a distance, so the pattern needs study.
Trunk with both edges in front of a brick building shows grey-brown bark in vertical plates with curling edges. Nothing makes it harder.
A large pale grey trunk with a fork and lichen in bright winter sun, shot slightly upward toward the sky. Angle for the upward view.
A frame-filling close-up of ridged, flaking bark with no trunk edge or scale object. A warm reddish tone shifts the bark colour.
A multi-stemmed old trunk in a forest with yellow autumn foliage behind; the bark is seen from a distance with dappled sun and shadow, so texture and pattern need study.
A single dry brown paired samara with its stalk on a plain purple background with a 1 cm scale bar. Nothing makes it harder.
A frame-filling close-up of grey, lichen-flecked bark with vertical ridges and furrows; no trunk edge or scale object.
A frame-filling close-up of grey bark in long vertical plates that curl at the edges; no trunk edge or scale object.
Trunk with both edges in a wood shows furrowed grey bark with pale lichen patches and a thin vine. Nothing makes it harder.
Fallen yellow, orange and red autumn leaves on the ground with a central yellow leaf; the leaves crowd each other, so the margin needs study. Autumn colour makes it an unusual look.

A single fallen samara half lying on snow, already germinating with a radicle. The germinating, detached form is not the typical look of the fruit (atypical), and it is after seed fall, so usual_look is false.
A wide mature trunk with both edges in frame, showing the pale grey scaly, loosely plated bark clearly in even light.

Deeply lobed green leaves seen from below against the sky, with the central leaf outline readable. Several leaves crowd the frame (alone false), the view from below is an unusual angle, and backlight changes the colour.

One lobed leaf against a dark background, lobes and rounded tips clear. The frame cuts off the leaf base and a lobe tip (whole false), and the flash-like, high-contrast light with deep shade behind gives the leaf a grey-blue cast.

A sunlit branch of many overlapping lobed leaves with a few small green acorns. The leaves are small and crowded in the frame, so their outlines and edges need close study, and no single leaf shows in full.
A drooping branch covered in many overlapping lobed leaves over a lawn. The leaves crowd one another and are small in the frame, so outline and edge need a search, though a central leaf shows whole.
A cluster of dry, tan paired samaras hanging on long stalks from a leafless twig against a soft background. Warm low sun backlights the cluster and changes its colour.
Two ripe brown acorns on a plain blue studio background, one with its warty cap, with a 1 cm scale bar. Shape, kind and cap are all clear; the hang on the twig is not shown.
A branch of many wet, green, round-lobed leaves over pine straw, with several whole outlines readable. The leaves crowd the frame, so alone is false.
Green acorns of full shape with warty caps sitting on the twig among lobed leaves. The acorns are not yet ripe, so growth_stage is unripe and usual_look false.
A large trunk with its edge and a building behind, showing loose scaly plates. Strong dappled sun and shadow patches change the colour across the bark.
A trunk in open woodland with both edges in frame, showing small blocky grey plates clearly in even light.
A pale grey trunk with its edges in frame, showing shallow scaly plates clearly in even light over a soft lawn background.
The camera looks up a forked trunk into the leafy crown, so the bark is shaded, backlit and foreshortened, and the crown competes with it. Bark looking up into the crown is a reject.
A hanging cluster of paired samaras with green seeds and papery wings on long stalks, against a soft background. The fruit has full shape but the green seeds show it is not ripe.
A green lobed leaf with several holes and a row of galls on one lobe (damaged). Its lower part is hidden behind other leaves that also compete in the frame.
A green acorn with a warty cap rests behind a large leaf that fills most of the frame and hides the lower part of the cap (whole false, alone false). The acorn is of full shape but not ripe.

A twig with a dense cluster of paired samaras with green seeds, plus a few leaves, shot with flash on a black background. The flash changes the colours, and the green seeds show the fruit is not yet ripe.
A whorl of deeply lobed leaves at a twig tip with stalks joining the twig, over a mass of other leaves. The leaves crowd the frame, and deep shade gives them a dull blue-grey cast.
A mature trunk with its edges in frame, showing long scaly plates clearly in soft light.
One green full-size acorn with its warty cap on the twig among white oak leaves. Full shape but not ripe, so growth_stage unripe and usual_look false.
Dead brown oak leaves in the litter, crowded and overlapping, with low sun and deep shadows. The subject is a dead leaf, so dead_leaf.
A cluster of green acorns with warty caps sitting on the twig among white oak leaves. Full shape but unripe, so usual_look false.
One whole lobed leaf with bristle tips seen from below against the sky. Backlight and the view from below make it harder.
Base of a large trunk with both edges in frame, showing grey ridged bark with flat-topped ridges. A small tag on the trunk is not readable, so no name_label.
A cluster of new spring leaves with catkins, backlit and translucent. Leaves are young and overlap each other, so shape is search, whole false and alone false.
The camera looks up the trunk into the crown; the bark is dark and its striped ridges show only far up. Looking up into the crown is bark_up_or_dark.
Many green lobed leaves on a hanging branch, crowded and overlapping in dappled sun. Crowding makes alone false and shape search.
Three green acorns with warty caps on the twig among white oak leaves. Full shape but unripe, so usual_look false.
A small shoot of broad, shallowly lobed leaves growing from the trunk, an epicormic sprout. Sprout leaves are not the mature form, so sucker_leaf.
A cluster of green lobed leaves at a twig tip seen from above against the forest floor; the stalks join the twig in the centre. Outlines and bristle-tipped lobes are readable.
New yellow-green spring leaves with hanging catkins, backlit. Leaves are young, crowded and partly hidden by catkins, so shape and margin are search.
A section of crown in red autumn colour; the small leaves blend into a mass. leaf_mass; autumn colour sets usual_look false.
A whorl of orange-yellow leaves on a sapling shoot in harsh direct sun. The leaves are broad with shallow lobes, not the typical deeply lobed form, so atypical; colour sets usual_look false.
A branch of red autumn leaves against a conifer; the leaves are small in the frame and overlap, so shape and margin are search. Autumn colour sets usual_look false.
Green lobed leaves of an understory sapling over the forest floor, overlapping each other. Crowding makes alone false and shape search; a small hole does not change the outline.
Several pinkish ripening acorns with warty caps on dark foliage; the dark flash-like lighting shifts the colour. How they attach to the twig is only partly shown.
Green bristle-lobed leaves on a branch, with stalks joining the twig at the top. Many leaves overlap, so alone false.
A whole small tree in red autumn colour among conifers in a landscape. The main subject is a crown, so part is other.
View up a trunk into the crown; the ridged bark with pale stripes is readable near the base. The camera looks up into the crown, so bark_up_or_dark.
View up into an autumn crown; yellow and green leaves blend into a mass, so no single leaf outline or edge is readable. Angle from below; autumn colour.
Close, sharp frame of grey interlacing furrowed bark; the ridge pattern repeats across the frame. Texture only, with no trunk edge or scale object, so too_close.
Crown view with orange flowers among the foliage; the leaves blend into a mass and no single outline is easy to read. Viewed from below.

Whole trunk section with edges shown against a busy street scene; the fine furrows are small in the frame and partly covered by lichen patches, so texture and pattern need study. The street background competes.
Single ripe acorn hanging from its stalk, sharp against a soft background; cap scales and nut outline are clear.
Four views of acorns on a black background: cap top, nut base, a capped acorn in side view, and a bare nut. Kind, shape and cap read clearly; no twig, so hang is not shown.
Leafy twig with several four-lobed, notched-tip leaves and a flower bud at the centre; the outlines and stalk joins are readable, but the crowded foliage competes.

Low shoot among ground vegetation with deeply and irregularly lobed leaves, not the typical four-lobed tulip-tree leaf; this looks like a sucker or sprout form that the source does not name for the mature tree. The surrounding plants compete.
Leafy twig with several squared-off lobed leaves and a green cone-like fruit at the centre; outlines and stalk joins are readable, but overlapping leaves crowd the frame.
Close frame of fissured, blocky ridged bark with lichen; pattern repeats clearly. Warm low sun tints the colour; texture only, with no trunk edge or scale, so too_close.
Trunk filling the frame with both edges visible; long flat-topped grey ridges and shallow furrows are clear and sharp.
Newly unfolding leaves and stipules on a twig tip against blue sky; the leaves are young, partly curled and backlit, so the outline needs study.
Specimen photo on a plain blue backdrop: a capped acorn, a cut nut and a nut base, with a 1 cm scale bar. Kind, shape and cap are clear; no twig, so hang is not shown.
One whole green leaf on a dark background, showing the four lobes, notched tip and smooth margin clearly; a few small spots do not change the outline.
Crown edge against sky viewed from below in warm low sun; the leaves are small and blend into a mass, so no single outline is readable.
Flowering branch with several squared lobed leaves along the twig; the leaf outlines and stalk joins are readable, but two open flowers compete for attention.
Green, full-size acorns with shallow caps sitting on twigs among leaves; the nuts are not yet ripe, and the twigs and leaves compete.
One whole green leaf held over dark ground with fallen yellow leaves; the lobes, notched tip and margin are clear against the soft background.
Crowded flowering branch with many yellow-orange flowers among the leaves; leaf outlines are small and overlapping, so they need a search, and the flowers compete.
Five ripe capped acorns on a plain white cloth; kind, shape and cap are clear. They are off the twig, so hang is not shown.
View from below into a mostly bare crown with scattered autumn leaves and fruit remnants; no single part is the subject, so part is other. Angle for the upward view.
Close frame of deeply furrowed, interlacing ridges with some lichen; the pattern repeat shows well. Too close: texture only, no trunk edge or scale.
Trunk with both edges in frame, showing narrow interlacing ridges and pale furrows; background is secondary.
Large old trunk from a distance in a shaded forest; the furrows show but are small and dark in the frame, so key features are search. Light for deep shade.
Frosted cones of samaras upright on bare twigs against a soft blue background; the central cone is full, the side ones partly shed. Individual wings need close study.
Several trunks in a winter woodland seen from a distance; the fine furrows need close study and other trunks and branches compete.
Two fruit cones upright on a twig against a soft autumn-foliage background; the fruits are small in the frame, so kind and shape are search.
Camera looks up the trunk into the green crown; the lower bark ridges read but the crown dominates. Angle for the upward view and light for dappled sun and shade.
One tan cone of samaras upright on a bare twig against a soft blue sky; individual wings need close study.
Top view of the rosette of persistent samaras left after seed fall, against snow; the wings are clear but the top view hides the cone outline. Angle for the top view.
Close frame of vertical furrowed ridges heavily covered with yellow lichen, which hides the bark colour. Too close: no trunk edge or scale.
Single brown cone of samaras on its stalk against a black background; no twig, so hang is no. Light for the flash.
Two children stand in front of a huge trunk and cover much of the lower bark; the furrows need close study. Light for patchy sun and shade.
Trunk with edges in frame showing interlacing ridges with pale furrows.
Sunlit trunk against sky and dark shade, with clear interlacing furrowed ridges.
Trunk with edges in frame showing interlacing ridges and pale diamond-shaped furrows.
A weathered, fallen cone of samaras lying in litter with loose samaras and clover; the debris competes. Atypical for the fallen, worn form.
Brown, partly opening cone of samaras with soft autumn leaves around it; the attachment to the twig is hard to see.
Single brown cone of samaras upright on a twig against a soft green and yellow background.
Green, full-size but unripe cone of samaras upright on a twig among leaves; the wings are not yet separate.

One large lobed leaf seen from below against the sky light, with other leaves behind it. Backlight and the low angle change the colour and view, the lowest lobe tip touches the frame edge, and the leaves behind compete.
A shoot of several green lobed leaves on a busy autumn background. The leaves crowd each other, so the subject is not alone and the small teeth need close study.
A shoot of overlapping leaves in mixed green, red, and orange autumn colour against a bright sky. Backlight tints the leaves, the leaves crowd each other, and the autumn colour is not the usual look.
The camera looks up the white, patchy trunk into the bare crown against a blue sky. The mottled pattern is clear, but the upward view into the crown is a reject.
One whole lobed, toothed leaf on its twig against a dark background, small but sharp. Backlight brightens and yellows the green.
One large green lobed leaf with a coarse toothed edge over grass, with part of a second leaf at the left. Outline, margin, and veins are easy to read.
Two overlapping leaves held in a hand in front of the mottled trunk. The overlap hides part of each outline, the trunk competes, and holes tear the left leaf.
One lobed, toothed leaf on its twig against a black background, lit by flash. The flash changes the colour; brown spots do not change the outline.

An open cone of samaras upright on its stalk against snow, after most samaras have fallen. The cone shape is clear; the remaining samaras show their wings only with close study, and the post-seed-fall stage is not the usual look.
A close view of the camouflage patches of olive, white, and grey bark with flaking edges. The frame shows texture only, with no trunk edge or scale object.
The base of a trunk beside a street from a few metres away, with parked cars in the frame. The bark pattern is small in the frame and the cars compete.
Bare branches against a blue sky, seen from below, with small open fruit cones after seed fall. The fruits are small in the frame and the branches compete.
A whole green lobed, toothed leaf in the centre, with a young fruit ball on the twig. The neighbouring leaves crowd it; the small holes do not change the outline.
A sapling and its crown in bright sun, where the leaves blend into a mass. No single leaf margin can be read.
The camera looks up into a bare winter crown with mottled trunk and branches. The bark pattern is small and the upward view is a reject.
An old hollow tree with three mottled white and brown trunks, seen from a distance in green growth. The patchy pattern reads, but the texture needs close study and the vegetation competes.
A cut shoot of alternate lobed, toothed leaves laid on grey deck boards. Outlines, teeth, and the stalks joining the stem are easy to read; the lowest leaves run off the frame.
A trunk with flaking patches of white, tan, and brown bark, with branches crossing above. Warm light gives the image a slight yellow cast.
A speckled lobed leaf in deep shade, overlapped at the lower left by another leaf, with a yellowing leaf beside it. Deep shade darkens the colour and the overlap hides part of the outline.
One whole green lobed, toothed leaf against soft gravel. The surface is puckered but the outline and margin are easy to read.
A green seed ball of full shape on its stalk against a leaf; it is not ripe, so growth_stage unripe. The twig is out of frame, so hang is search.

One mature leaf held in a hand with other leaves crowding behind it; the bottom lobe tip touches the frame edge, so whole false. Brown lesions and a curled, damaged edge on the right lobe change the outline.
The camera looks up into a bare crown of white limbs against the sky; the white colour reads but the texture and pattern are far and small, and the view up into the crown is a reject.
Many ripe seed balls on bare branches seen from below at a distance; each ball is small in the frame, so the key features are search.
Five ripe brown seed balls hang on long single stalks from a bare twig against a plain blue sky.
Close view of mottled, peeling patchwork bark around a burl; the frame shows texture only, with no trunk edge or scale object, so too_close is true.
A fallen, broken-up seed ball on a log with a bare core and loose achenes beside it; the ball is not in its typical form, so the kind and shape take study.
The base of a large trunk at a curb, with dark scaly bark and white patches at the root flare; the bark is seen from a distance, so its texture is search.
A small young seed ball with styles on its stalk from a twig, beside an unfolding new leaf in spring; the fruit is young, not yet at full size.
A trunk with smooth mottled green-grey and white bark and peeling patches; foliage and flowers in the foreground compete with it, so alone is false.
A scene of an avenue of trees whose crowns form an arch of green leaves over a path; no single part is the subject.
A yellow-green seed ball of full shape hangs on its stalk from a bare twig, with brown balls in the background; this one is not ripe.
A green seed ball of full shape on its stalk against soft yellowing autumn leaves; the twig join is out of frame, so hang is search, and the ball is not ripe.
A trunk shot from below up into the crown, white upper bark over a brown peeling lower trunk; the bark is far and the view looks up into the crown, a reject.
A broken seed ball on a log: a dark core with a ring of hairy achenes splayed out flat; this is not the typical ball form, so kind and shape take study.
Many ripe tan seed balls hang singly on curved stalks from bare twigs against a plain blue sky.
A hanging seed ball breaking apart, with hairy achenes spilling from one side against a soft background; the broken ball is not the typical form.
A single greenish seed ball on a long stalk from a bare twig against a soft grey background; its green colour marks it as not ripe.
A trunk covered in peeling brown plates over pale inner bark, with its edges in frame against a winter woodland.
A close view of one ripe brown seed ball with a soft background; the stalk runs out of frame to the twig, so hang is search.
Crowded green leaves seen from below against a bright sky, with one seed ball and a car behind. Leaves overlap and are backlit, so outline and edge need study.
Trunk with both edges, showing the typical flaking brown plates over pale cream patches.
Backlit leaves seen from below beside a peeling trunk that competes for attention; the overexposed sky washes out the leaf outlines and edges.
Sunlit trunk with both edges, showing the classic patchwork of brown flaking plates over pale yellow-cream bark.
Close bark frame with no trunk edge or scale. Deep shade over the right half dulls the colour and hides the patch pattern, so the pattern needs study.
Narrow trunk with both edges against a plain wall, showing mottled brown, cream and green patches. Small file but sharp.
Frame-filling close-up of camouflage bark with green, yellow and brown patches; no trunk edge or scale object, so texture only.
A dead brown fallen leaf on grass among other dead leaves; its lower lobes are overlapped. The subject is a dead leaf.
Camera looks up the trunk into a bare crown against bright sky; the trunk is backlit and dark, so the patch pattern is hard to read.
Trunk with both edges and a soft green background, showing the smooth white and grey-green patchwork.
Close view of a few peeling plates with no trunk edge. Warm low sun and hard shadow shift the colour, and the frame is too tight to show the pattern repeat.
A green leaf held up against the trunk, seen from below at a tilt; its base is covered by another leaf and a hand and the right lobe runs off the frame, so the full outline needs study.
Street scene of an avenue of plane trees with cyclists; no leaf, bark or fruit is the subject.
Several green seed balls hanging on long stalks among leaves, seen from below against blue sky. The balls are small in the frame and the leaves compete; each stalk shows one ball.
Underside of one green leaf held in a hand; the hand covers part of the lower blade, so whole is false. Small spots do not change the outline.
A section of crown where the leaves blend into a dense green mass behind a branch; no single leaf stands out.
One whole green leaf with its long stalk against a dark soft background; the stalk's join to the twig is partly hidden by smaller leaves.
A spray of green leaves in front of a soft-focus patchy trunk, which competes for attention; the central leaf outline and toothed lobes read well.
Trunk with both edges showing a fine jigsaw of pale grey and buff flaking plates.
Trunk with the right edge visible, heavily covered in grey-green lichen and algae that partly hides the patch pattern and its colour.
One brown, ripe seed ball held in a hand over fallen autumn leaves; ball fully visible and sharp. Held in hand, so hang is no.
Two ripe brown seed balls in a chain on one stalk against soft winter branches and sky; both balls sharp and whole.
A small green, unripe seed ball resting in a hand on its stalk below leaves; the ball is small in the frame and the hand and leaves compete, so kind is search and alone false.
A fallen seed ball breaking apart on paving, with loose hairy achenes around it, seen from above; the breaking ball is not the typical form (atypical) and the top view is an angle.
A green, full-size unripe seed ball hanging on its stalk among green leaves; ball sharp and central.
A green spiky unripe seed ball hanging from a long stalk against a soft background; the stalk shows but not where it joins the twig, so hang is search.
Green unripe seed balls, two or three on one hanging stalk below a leaf; the multiple heads on one stalk show clearly.
A section of crown with many overlapping green leaves and tiny seed balls; the leaves blend into a mass and no single leaf stands out, so leaf_mass.

A small greenish seed ball hanging on its stalk in a sunlit autumn scene with brown leaves and a trunk; the ball is small and competes with the scene, and warm low sun with backlight changes the colours.
A dark brown seed ball hanging on its stalk among green leaves, seen from below; the view from below and the backlight make the ball dark.
Several ripe brown seed balls hanging singly on long stalks from bare winter twigs against blue sky, seen from below (angle).
Many autumn leaves overlap on a small plant. Several leaves show lobes but the outlines compete with neighbours, so shape and margin need a search. Autumn colour, not usual look.
Crowded green leaves on a branch in partial shade with opposite stalks visible. No single leaf outline stands alone, so shape and margin need close study. Shade darkens the leaves.
Autumn twig with opposite leaves, several lobed outlines readable in the centre among busy red and orange leaves. Autumn colour so not the usual look.
Whole trunk seen from a distance, mossy and furrowed, with the trunk edge and branches in frame. Ridges are small in the frame, so texture and pattern need a search.
Dense yellow autumn leaves crowd the foreground, wide angle with warm sun and a red tree behind. Outlines overlap and the frame edge cuts leaves. Warm light shifts colour.
A whole small plant at a distance with leaves blended into a mass among grass and asters. No single outline can be read.
One green leaf in sharp focus against a soft background. Lobes, toothed edge and veins are readable.
Trunk seen from a distance in an autumn woodland scene with lichen patches. The bark is small and dark, so the ridge pattern needs a search.
Three trunks fused at the base with backlight from behind. Shaded furrows are readable but the pattern repeat is split by the multiple trunks.
Close view of deep vertical ridges with narrow furrows, texture only with no trunk edge or scale.
One red autumn leaf with clear lobes among brown leaf litter and a mushroom. The surroundings compete and the edge is small in frame. Autumn colour.
Shaggy, scaly plates on a broad trunk with a hand at the left edge for scale. Ridges and plates are readable.
Wide close-up of ridged grey bark with lichen, no trunk edge or scale. Ridges and plates are clear.
Straight trunk with narrow vertical ridges, edges in frame, and ferns behind. Ridge pattern is readable.
A red-orange autumn leaf tilted slightly, against conifer needles that compete. Lobes and teeth are readable. Autumn colour.
Camera looks up the trunk into the crown with strong sun glare and a birdhouse on the bark. The bark is hard to read.
Backlit autumn leaves, soft and overlapping, with orange-red tones. Outlines can be traced only with study. Backlight changes colour.
Large red-green autumn leaf with clear lobes and teeth, but the frame edge cuts the lower and side parts and other leaves crowd it. Autumn colour.

Whole trunk with trunk edges, street behind it. The fine vertical ridges are faint under patches of lichen, so the pattern needs close study.

Branch tips of a crown against blue sky. Leaves are small and form a mass, so there is no single subject.
Two open yellow-orange tulip-shaped flowers on a twig with leaves. Flowers are the main subject, so the part is other.
Three full-shape green acorns on a twig, showing how they sit. They are unripe, and leaves behind them compete for attention.
One whole green leaf, upper side, over fallen autumn leaves on soft ground. The outline is clear, with shallow side lobes.
Leafy crown with many yellow-orange flowers and buds. A scene with several flowers, no single leaf.

A whole crown of a leafless-looking tree with fruit clusters and a few yellow autumn leaves against sky. No single leaf, bark, or fruit is the subject, so the part is other.
Close, sharp view of crossing diagonal ridges on old grey bark with some lichen. The frame shows texture only, with no trunk edge, branch, or scale, so too_close is true.
A full trunk with both edges in frame and clear narrow ridges and furrows in even light. Sharp and easy to read.

Close view of deep vertical ridges covered with yellow-green lichen. No trunk edge or scale is in the frame, and the lichen hides the true bark colour.
A dry cone of samaras on a black background, lit by flash. The fruit is sharp and whole, but only a short stalk shows, so the hang is not readable. The flash changes the colours.
Two children stand in front of a huge mossy trunk in dappled shade. The people dominate the frame and the bark detail is small and dim.
Full trunk width with lichen flecks, ridges, and furrows, evenly lit and sharp. Both trunk edges show.
Trunk with clear furrows and ridges, sharp, against a dark background. Easy to read.
Sunlit trunk with pale furrows between flat ridges, sky and leaves behind. Clear and sharp.
A weathered pale cone lying on the ground among dead grass, clover, and litter. The clutter competes with it, and the fruit kind needs close study.

A close frame of mottled olive, brown and white peeling bark, with the pattern repeat visible but no trunk edge, branch or scale object.

Bare branches against a blue sky with a few small dry fruit remnants. The main subject is a crown, so the part is other.

A pale, mottled trunk with leaves around it, and the trunk edges and a branch scar showing. The flaking pattern reads well.
